data.title: Apple II and S-100 expansion products launch

actions.description: Logix launches the existing Apple II Expansion Card and FlexiDisk II plus three new products: S-100 FlexiBUS Interface, Apple II Video Card, and S-100 Video Card. Cards initially use AION chips. Native Apple drivers/examples and supported S-100 CP/M adapters accompany the cards; Apple participation does not imply an S-100 endorsement.
An Apple representative participates in the demonstration.
